nodes.zh: 玩家要一個流派
nodes.en: The player asks for a build

nodes.zh: 套用流程：poe2-advisor skill、build_guide prompt 或 build_workflow 工具
nodes.en: Apply the workflow: the poe2-advisor skill, the build_guide prompt or the build_workflow tool

nodes.zh:
步驟 2：由資料找候選。每個選擇都要有資料上的理由，不能是「天梯都在用」
lookup_entity、gems_by、supports_for、passives_with_stat、get_gem、get_passive
nodes.en:
Step 2: gather candidates from the data. Every choice needs a reason from the records, never 'ladder characters use it'
lookup_entity, gems_by, supports_for, passives_with_stat, get_gem, get_passive

nodes.zh:
裝備：items_by、get_item 選基底或傳奇，modifiers_for 選目標詞綴
每件最多 3 條前綴 + 3 條後綴，依重要性排列
nodes.en:
Gear: items_by and get_item for a base or unique, modifiers_for for target modifiers
At most 3 prefixes + 3 suffixes per item, in order of importance

nodes.zh:
步驟 3：verify_build
一次送出所有寶石、天賦、裝備與目標詞綴
nodes.en:
Step 3: verify_build
All gems, passives, items and target modifiers in one call

nodes.zh: 有 unverified 的名稱？
nodes.en: Any unverified names?

nodes.zh:
步驟 4（最多兩輪）
刪除該名稱，或用 suggestions、重新搜尋取代
nodes.en:
Step 4 (at most two rounds)
Drop the name, or replace it from its suggestions or a new search

nodes.zh:
步驟 5：path_to
職業或昇華 + 已驗證的天賦 → 路線、順序、點數
nodes.en:
Step 5: path_to
Class or ascendancy + verified passives → route, order, points

nodes.zh: over：超過 123 點或昇華 8 點？
nodes.en: over: more than 123 points, or 8 ascendancy points?

nodes.zh: 拿掉 added_points 最大的天賦
nodes.en: Drop the passives with the largest added_points

nodes.zh:
步驟 6：reference_builds
讀天梯快照，只用來說明與主流的差異；不含角色名稱
nodes.en:
Step 6: reference_builds
Reads the ladder snapshot, only to say how the build differs. No character names

nodes.zh:
步驟 7：撰寫回答
數字、消耗、標籤、效果只用 verified 的事實
目標詞綴是要找的目標；不計算傷害
nodes.en:
Step 7: write the answer
Numbers, costs, tags and effects from verified facts only
Target modifiers are goals to look for. Damage is not calculated

nodes.zh: 步驟 8：結尾附上 sources_markdown，原樣貼上（內含被移除的名稱）
nodes.en: Step 8: end with sources_markdown, unchanged (it lists the removed names)

nodes.zh:
步驟 9：export_pob
職業、targets、技能組、裝備；使用者指定等級時傳入 character_level
nodes.en:
Step 9: export_pob
Class, targets, skill groups, gear, and character_level when the user asked for a level

nodes.zh: 屬性或精魂的 need 大於 have？
nodes.en: Attributes or Spirit: need above have?

nodes.zh: 換寶石、減少常駐技能或保留精魂的輔助寶石，或在裝備加上屬性、精魂詞綴
nodes.en: Other gems, fewer persistent skills or Spirit-reserving supports, or attribute and Spirit modifiers on gear

nodes.zh:
回答附上：匯入碼、how_to_import、notes、not_exported、
屬性與精魂的已有／需求、PoB 配置選項與各自的依據
nodes.en:
The answer shows: the code, how_to_import, notes, not_exported,
have / need for attributes and Spirit, PoB Configuration options with their evidence

nodes.zh: 玩家把匯入碼貼進 PoB：匯入/匯出 → 貼上 → 匯入
nodes.en: The player pastes the code into PoB: Import/Export Build → paste → Import

edges.zh: 沒有，或已修兩輪（仍未通過的捨棄）
edges.en: none, or two rounds done (what still fails is dropped)

edges.zh: 否；修不了就明白說出缺什麼
edges.en: no. If it cannot be fixed, say plainly what is missing

nodes.zh:
export_pob 的輸入：職業或昇華、targets、技能組、裝備
可選：character_level、attribute、config
nodes.en:
export_pob input: class or ascendancy, targets, skill groups, gear
Optional: character_level, attribute, config

nodes.zh:
天賦路線：path_to
PoB 沒有 id 的昇華被拿掉，路線重算
nodes.en:
Passive route: path_to
An ascendancy PoB has no id for is dropped and the route is made again

nodes.zh: 技能組：逐一檢查名稱；輔助寶石必須能輔助該技能
nodes.en: Skill groups: each name is checked. A support must be able to support the skill

nodes.zh: 不通過的名稱、輔助寶石、詞綴不放入匯入碼，列在 not_exported
nodes.en: Names, supports and modifiers that fail stay out of the code and are listed in not_exported

nodes.zh:
裝備：基底與傳奇對照本地資料
稀有詞綴必須是該類裝備能出的完整詞綴：3 前綴 + 3 後綴、同族群一條
數值取最高階的上限；副手規則依 PoB
nodes.en:
Gear: bases and uniques against the local data
A rare's modifiers must be whole modifiers the item class can roll: 3 prefixes + 3 suffixes, one per family
Values at the upper end of the best tier. Off-hand rules follow PoB

nodes.zh: 有指定 character_level？
nodes.en: Was character_level given?

nodes.zh: 使用指定的等級；點數需要更高等級時加註
nodes.en: Use that level, with a note when the points need a higher one

nodes.zh: 用掉的天賦點 → PoB 的等級公式與章節表（123 點為 100 級）
nodes.en: Points spent → PoB's level formula and act table (123 points is level 100)

nodes.zh:
寶石等級：等級表中需求不高於角色等級的最高一列，最高 20
輔助寶石沒有等級
nodes.en:
Gem levels: the highest level-table row the character level allows, at most 20
Support gems have no level

nodes.zh:
屬性
需求 = 各技能寶石需求的最大值、輔助「+N」的總和、裝備需求的最大值，三者取最大
已有 = 職業基礎值 + 天賦與裝備上的固定屬性
nodes.en:
Attributes
need = the highest of: each skill gem's requirement, the supports' +N summed, the highest gear requirement
have = class base + fixed attributes on passives and gear

nodes.zh: 路線上的屬性天賦點優先補足需求，或依指定的 attribute
nodes.en: Attribute passives on the route cover the requirements first, or follow attribute

nodes.zh:
精魂
需求 =（常駐技能保留量 + 輔助的額外保留）× 保留倍率
已有 = 所有精魂任務獎勵 + 權杖基礎精魂 + 裝備與天賦的固定精魂
只給範圍或沒給保留量的技能列入 unknown
nodes.en:
Spirit
need = (persistent skill's reservation + supports' extra) × reservation multipliers
have = every Spirit quest reward + a sceptre's base Spirit + fixed Spirit on gear and passives
Range-only or missing reservations are listed in unknown

nodes.zh: config 開啟？（預設開啟）
nodes.en: Is config on? (on by default)

nodes.zh:
逐項找依據，有才開啟
球：流派會獲得　　敵人狀態：流派會造成
感電、冰緩、點燃：該元素的傷害技能，或攻擊流派的主手武器
「無法……」的句子排除該技能組　　曝曬、近期暴擊
nodes.en:
Each option needs evidence in the build
Charges it gains. Enemy states it inflicts
Shock, Chill, Ignite: a damaging skill of that element, or an attack build's main-hand weapon
A 'cannot …' line rules it out for its skill group. Exposure, Crit Recently

nodes.zh: 寫成 PoB 的 XML：Build、Tree、Skills、Items、Config、Notes
nodes.en: Written as PoB's XML: Build, Tree, Skills, Items, Config, Notes

nodes.zh: zlib 壓縮 → urlsafe base64
nodes.en: zlib → urlsafe base64

nodes.zh:
回傳 code、how_to_import、notes、not_exported、summary
不寫檔、不連網
nodes.en:
Returns code, how_to_import, notes, not_exported, summary
No file written, no request made

nodes.zh: /pobg:status
nodes.en: /pobg:status

nodes.zh: data_status：只讀本地檔案，不連網
nodes.en: data_status: reads local files only, no network

nodes.zh: 每類資料列出：筆數、抓取時間、天數，以及可以用哪個 update 範圍更新
nodes.en: Per data set: records, fetch time, age in days, and which update scope refreshes it

nodes.zh: 指出過舊的資料，包含天梯快照與它的聯盟
nodes.en: Point out what is old, including the ladder snapshot and its league

nodes.zh: 詢問使用者：要檢查線上網站嗎？
nodes.en: Ask the user: check the live sites?

nodes.zh: data_status check_online=true：約 19 個請求，間隔 0.8 秒
nodes.en: data_status check_online=true: about 19 requests, 0.8 s apart

nodes.zh: poe2db：各類頁面是否仍能照 catalog 的描述解析
nodes.en: poe2db: do the pages of each kind still parse the way the catalog expects

nodes.zh: GitHub：PathOfBuilding-PoE2 有沒有新的天賦樹版本
nodes.en: GitHub: is there a newer PathOfBuilding-PoE2 passive tree version

nodes.zh: 回報 problems
nodes.en: Report problems

nodes.zh: 有需要更新的資料？
nodes.en: Anything that should be updated?

nodes.zh: 結束
nodes.en: Done

nodes.zh: 告訴使用者指令：/pobg:update 加一個範圍
nodes.en: Name the command: /pobg:update with one scope

nodes.zh: /pobg:update 範圍 [名稱]
nodes.en: /pobg:update scope [names]

nodes.zh: 第一個字是七個範圍之一嗎？
nodes.en: Is the first word one of the seven scopes?

nodes.zh: 不呼叫 update_data，請使用者選一個範圍
nodes.en: update_data is not called. The user is asked to pick a scope

nodes.zh: update_data：檢查參數（名稱最多 40 個）
nodes.en: update_data: arguments are checked (at most 40 names)

nodes.zh: 同一個資料夾已有 update、refresh 或線上檢查在跑？
nodes.en: Is an update, refresh or online check already running on this data folder?

nodes.zh: 回報忙碌中，請稍後再試；不寫入
nodes.en: Reports busy, try again later. Nothing written

nodes.zh:
依範圍進入對應的流程（各有一張圖）
skill_gems、spirit_gems、support_gems → 寶石
passives → 天賦樹
items → 裝備
glossary → 名詞解釋
ladder → 天梯
nodes.en:
The scope decides the flow (one chart each)
skill_gems, spirit_gems, support_gems → gems
passives → passive tree
items → items
glossary → glossary
ladder → ladder

nodes.zh: 寫入後重建名稱索引；server 在鎖外重新載入資料
nodes.en: After writing, the name index is rebuilt and the server reloads the data outside the lock

nodes.zh: 同一個對話立刻看到新資料
nodes.en: The same conversation sees the new data

nodes.zh:
範圍是 skill_gems、spirit_gems 或 support_gems
可加寶石名稱，或「超過 N 天」
nodes.en:
The scope is skill_gems, spirit_gems or support_gems
Optionally gem names, or 'older than N days'

nodes.zh: update_data dry_run=true：抓列表頁，1 個請求
nodes.en: update_data dry_run=true: fetches the listing page, 1 request

nodes.zh:
挑出要抓的寶石：新增的、列表上有變動的、指定名稱的、超過 N 天沒更新的
15 分鐘內抓過的寶石不再抓
nodes.en:
Select the gems to fetch: new, changed on the listing, named by you, older than N days
A gem fetched in the last 15 minutes is not fetched again

nodes.zh: 告訴使用者：selected、reasons、added、removed
nodes.en: Tell the user: selected, reasons, added, removed

nodes.zh: selected 等於 0？
nodes.en: Is selected 0?

nodes.zh: 這類資料已是最新，結束
nodes.en: This data set is up to date. Stop

nodes.zh: selected 超過 60？
nodes.en: Is selected above 60?

nodes.zh:
請使用者確認：每顆寶石一個請求
不同意就結束，不寫入
nodes.en:
Ask the user to confirm: one request per gem
Without a yes it stops and nothing is written

nodes.zh:
update_data dry_run=false
每次最多 20 顆（上限 40），每頁間隔 0.8 秒
nodes.en:
update_data dry_run=false
At most 20 gems per call (40 at most), 0.8 s between pages

nodes.zh: 頁面還能解析、驗證通過？
nodes.en: Do the pages still parse and pass validation?

nodes.zh:
中止，不寫入任何東西
建議用 status 檢查線上網站
nodes.en:
Stops, nothing is written
Suggests status with the online check

nodes.zh:
寫回該類寶石的資料檔
下載失敗的單一頁面列為 skipped，下次再抓
nodes.en:
Writes that gem kind's data file
A single page that fails to download is listed as skipped and picked up next time

nodes.zh: left 大於 0，且未滿 10 次呼叫？
nodes.en: Is left above 0, with fewer than 10 calls made?

nodes.zh: 回報 updated、added、removed、skipped
nodes.en: Report updated, added, removed, skipped

nodes.zh: 範圍是 passives（不接受其他參數）
nodes.en: The scope is passives (no other argument)

nodes.zh:
一次呼叫，共 8 個請求
GitHub：tree.json（節點、連線、職業起點、昇華）
GitHub：QuestRewards.lua（PoB 等級用的章節表、精魂任務獎勵）
poe2db：天賦樹資料檔 data_us、data_tw（每個節點的中文名稱與屬性）
poe2db：Keystone、Notable 列表頁，中英共 4 頁
nodes.en:
One call, 8 requests
GitHub: tree.json (nodes, connections, class starts, ascendancies)
GitHub: QuestRewards.lua (PoB's act table for the level, Spirit quest rewards)
poe2db: tree data files data_us, data_tw (Chinese name and stats of every node)
poe2db: Keystone and Notable listings, English and Chinese, 4 pages

nodes.zh: QuestRewards.lua 下載成功？
nodes.en: Was QuestRewards.lua downloaded?

nodes.zh: 照常更新天賦樹；匯入碼改用備用的等級算法並加註
nodes.en: The tree is still updated. Build codes fall back for the level, with a note

nodes.zh: 組出節點、邊與 classes.json
nodes.en: Build nodes, edges and classes.json

nodes.zh: 驗證通過？
nodes.en: Does validation pass?

nodes.zh: 中止，不寫入
nodes.en: Stops, nothing written

nodes.zh: 寫入節點、邊、classes.json；重建屬性索引與名稱索引
nodes.en: Writes nodes, edges and classes.json. Rebuilds the stat index and the name index

nodes.zh: 回報 records、changed、added、removed 與天賦樹版本
nodes.en: Report records, changed, added, removed and the tree versions

nodes.zh:
範圍是 items
可加裝備類別名稱，例如 Bows
nodes.en:
The scope is items
Optionally item class names such as Bows

nodes.zh:
決定要抓的頁面
全部：69 個類別頁 × 中英 = 138 個請求
指定類別：只抓那幾類與其屬性子頁
nodes.en:
Decide the pages
All: 69 class pages in two languages = 138 requests
Named classes: only those and their attribute pages

nodes.zh:
update_data：這次呼叫最多 20 個請求
（10 個類別頁的中英兩版，每頁約 600 KB）
nodes.en:
update_data: at most 20 requests this call
(10 class pages in both languages, about 600 KB each)

nodes.zh: 進度暫存在 output/cache 30 分鐘，中斷後接續而不是重來
nodes.en: Progress is kept under output/cache for 30 minutes, so an interrupted run continues

nodes.zh: done：全部頁面都抓到了？
nodes.en: done: is every page fetched?

nodes.zh:
已滿 8 次呼叫：請使用者 30 分鐘內再下一次指令
到此為止沒有寫入
nodes.en:
8 calls made: ask the user to run the command again within 30 minutes
Nothing written so far

nodes.zh: 解析基底、傳奇與頁面內嵌的詞綴資料；中英對齊、計算階級
nodes.en: Parse bases, uniques and the modifier data in the page. Align English and Chinese, compute tiers

nodes.zh: 筆數與詞綴資料通過檢查？
nodes.en: Do the counts and modifier data pass the checks?

nodes.zh: 中止，不寫入
nodes.en: Stops, nothing written

nodes.zh:
一次寫入基底、傳奇、詞綴
只更新部分類別時與原有資料合併
nodes.en:
Writes bases, uniques and modifiers together
Merged with the existing data when only some classes were updated

nodes.zh: 回報 bases、uniques、modifiers
nodes.en: Report bases, uniques, modifiers

nodes.zh: 範圍是 glossary（不接受其他參數）
nodes.en: The scope is glossary (no other argument)

nodes.zh: update_data：這次呼叫最多 50 個請求，約一分鐘內
nodes.en: update_data: at most 50 requests this call, under a minute

nodes.zh:
透過列表頁與少數寶石頁找到名詞，再抓每個名詞的中英 hover 片段
全部約 750 個請求
nodes.en:
Terms are found through the listings and a few gem pages, then each term's English and Chinese hover snippet is fetched
About 750 requests in all

nodes.zh: 連續 5 次網路錯誤？
nodes.en: Five network errors in a row?

nodes.zh: 這次呼叫放棄，進度保留
nodes.en: This call gives up. Progress is kept

nodes.zh: done：全部抓完了？
nodes.en: done: is the whole glossary fetched?

nodes.zh: 已滿 20 次呼叫：請使用者 30 分鐘內再下一次指令，會從停下的地方接續
nodes.en: 20 calls made: ask the user to run the command again within 30 minutes. It continues where it stopped

nodes.zh: 抓到的名詞不少於原有的 90%，中文內容不少於原有的 50%？
nodes.en: At least 90% of the known terms reached, and Chinese text for at least 50% of those that had it?

nodes.zh: 不寫入
nodes.en: Not written

nodes.zh: 逐欄位合併後一次寫入；抓不到的名詞保留原本的內容
nodes.en: Merged field by field and written at once. Terms it could not reach keep their previous text

nodes.zh: 回報 records、refreshed、changed、added、kept_without_refresh
nodes.en: Report records, refreshed, changed, added, kept_without_refresh

nodes.zh: 範圍是 ladder（不接受其他參數）
nodes.en: The scope is ladder (no other argument)

nodes.zh: 一次呼叫，最多 14 個請求到 poe.ninja，間隔 0.8 秒
nodes.en: One call, at most 14 requests to poe.ninja, 0.8 s apart

nodes.zh: 讀目前聯盟與數種排序各前 100 名，共約 600 個角色
nodes.en: Reads the current league and the top 100 of several sort orders, about 600 characters

nodes.zh:
只留職業、等級、主技能、寶石、keystone、聯盟、排名
角色與帳號名稱在寫入前丟棄
nodes.en:
Keeps class, level, main skill, gems, keystones, league, rank
Character and account names are discarded before writing

nodes.zh:
快照看起來正常？
至少 100 筆、九成有職業、半數有技能；同聯盟時不少於上一份的一半
nodes.en:
Does the snapshot look right?
At least 100 rows, 90% with a class, half with a skill. Same league: not below half the previous one

nodes.zh: 拒絕寫入，保留舊快照
nodes.en: Refused. The old snapshot stays

nodes.zh: 取代天梯快照
nodes.en: Replaces the ladder snapshot

nodes.zh: 回報 records、league；聯盟換了還有 previous_league
nodes.en: Report records and league, and previous_league when the league changed

nodes.zh: /pobg:update-pob 資料夾
nodes.en: /pobg:update-pob folder

nodes.zh: 有給資料夾嗎？
nodes.en: Was a folder given?

nodes.zh: 請使用者提供後停止；不會搜尋硬碟
nodes.en: Ask for it and stop. The disk is never searched

nodes.zh: 路徑含有雙引號、反引號或錢字號？
nodes.en: Does the path contain a double quote, a backtick or a dollar sign?

nodes.zh:
不執行任何東西
請使用者改資料夾名稱，或自己執行指令
nodes.en:
Nothing is run
Rename the folder, or run the command yourself

nodes.zh:
第一步：加 --check 執行
2 個請求到 GitHub，不寫入
nodes.en:
First run: with --check
2 requests to GitHub, writes nothing

nodes.zh:
辨識資料夾
有 manifest.xml：單獨的 Path of Building
有 PoeCharm3.exe：PoeCharm2，PoB 在裡面
nodes.en:
Recognise the folder
manifest.xml: Path of Building alone
PoeCharm3.exe: PoeCharm2 with PoB inside

nodes.zh:
回報 installed 與 latest
PoeCharm2 另回報最新提交與日期
nodes.en:
Report installed and latest
For PoeCharm2 also its latest commit and date

nodes.zh: up_to_date？
nodes.en: up_to_date?

nodes.zh: 已是最新，結束
nodes.en: Already current. Stop

nodes.zh:
說明更新會做什麼
下載 PoB 正式版（約 380 MB）並核對 SHA-256
PoeCharm2 另下載約 30 MB，沒有公布的雜湊可核對
解壓到舊資料夾旁的新資料夾
nodes.en:
Explain what the update does
Downloads PoB's release (about 380 MB), checked against its SHA-256
PoeCharm2 also about 30 MB, with no published checksum
Unpacks into a new folder next to the old one

nodes.zh: 使用者同意？
nodes.en: Does the user agree?

nodes.zh: 結束，什麼都沒下載
nodes.en: Stop. Nothing downloaded

nodes.zh:
第二步：不加 --check 執行
可能要幾分鐘，逾時設 10 分鐘
nodes.en:
Second run: without --check
Can take minutes, with a 10-minute timeout

nodes.zh:
下載到暫存工作資料夾
PoB 不得超過公布的大小，PoeCharm2 上限 200 MB
nodes.en:
Downloads into a temporary work folder
